mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase amitriptyline metabolism via glucuronidation, potentially altering amitriptyline levels; amitriptyline may also increase estrogen levels through enterohepatic circulation inhibition.
action: Monitor for amitriptyline efficacy and adverse effects; consider dose adjustment if needed; counsel on bleeding risk and thromboembolic complications.
